verdict.rationale: Mem0 provides official Python/JavaScript SDKs with a quickstart (add/search calls), an OpenAPI spec, a CLI, and integration guides for 22 frameworks (LangChain, CrewAI, LlamaIndex, Vercel AI SDK, etc.), directly supporting AI-native developers building against official SDKs. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of SDK ergonomics or reliability beyond first-party docs.
